notes: The Medieval Kingdom pack town as the survival map (CireTownMap, Docs/CastleTown.md). Two identical copies of the pack's PL_CastleTown and its sublevels (never SL_Lighting) are streamed at the realm offsets; they differ only in lighting. Realm-local = pack coordinates - frameCenter; world = realm-local + realms[team].offset.xy + frameCenter. Gameplay spots live in CastleTownRoutes.json (realm-local, PROVISIONAL). The pack is Fab-licensed and never committed; without it the procedural town is used.

trim.notes: town-trim (Docs/CastleTown.md 'Trim to Play Bounds'): with a Play Bounds polygon in MapLayout.json, everything entirely outside it plus margin (cm) is not loaded, not rendered and not in the navmesh, in both realms. backdrop: off (cut everything), low (keep the landscape plus landmarks at least landmarkHeight tall or landmarkSize long, and the backdropLevels / backdropLevelInstances, as silhouettes: no collision, shadows, tick, lights or particles), full (keep every outside actor as a silhouette). backdropRange 0 = any distance. The layout editor and explore mode always load the whole town.

castleInterior.notes: town-trim (Eric's playtest: the castle was too dark to find the way). Warm, non-shadowing fill lights at realm-local anchors [x, y, z, radius] (z relative to the realm offset, from Tools/RunTownShots.py --scan: walkable spots under a roof near the castle goal) and yards [x, y, heightAboveGround, radius] (open courtyards). Mirrored to both realms, each on its realm's lighting channel; realms[].lighting.castleScale scales per realm. Castle only: house interiors stay dark (Eric's ruling).

water.notes: town-trim: the pack's WaterZone + WaterBodyOcean (surface Z -236) in both realms (CireTownWater). deepDepth: water deeper than this (cm) is cut out of the navmesh (units never path into it); shallower water stays walkable (wading, visual only). navCell: the depth sampling grid (cm). cvars: water quality applied on every rendering peer. views: extra before/after capture views (realm-local, z relative to the realm offset).
